description: Land Acquisition - Orugodawaththa in U.C. Limits of Kolonnawa, Kolonnawa D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain described lands are needed for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with their boundaries, extents, and assessment numbers. While it mentions a government minister (Minister of Lands), the core content focuses entirely on land matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette.
